text:
opsbot: :rotating_light: Pager — CycloneCore org (org_7721) high QPS detected, sustained 2m above 18k rps, incoming error rate climbing.
oncall-mike: I'm on it. pulling logs + enabling trace sampling 10%.
sre-ana: Looking at /metrics, burst to 22k p95 latency 320ms. Rate limit policy 'org_dynamic_v2' is throttling at 1.2k rps/org, many requests are short-chat completions.
eng-ryan: Do we want a temporary override? Can create a short TTL soft-bump to avoid customer 5xxs.
oncall-mike: Yes — request: CycloneCore needs relief ASAP. Proposal: bump to 4k rps for 30m with auto-rollback. Any objections?
acct-team: CycloneCore contact is @marie, they are in active campaign. Support escalation in progress.
sre-ana: No objections. Create override and route degraded requests to cheaper model variant as fallback.
oncall-mike: Applying override now via admin API:
```
POST /internal/orgs/7721/rate_override
{ "qps": 4000, "ttl": "30m", "reason": "emergency surge - campaign spike", "created_by": "oncall-mike" }
```
opsbot: Rate override accepted — override_id: ro_9f3b. Effective in 6s. :white_check_mark:
support-laura: Notifying CycloneCore support channel and their SRE contact. Sending status note.
eng-ryan: Also toggled feature-flag 'expensive-reranker' OFF for that org to reduce token cost.
sre-ana: Monitoring metrics and error rate. If latency drops under 200ms and errors <1% we can scale down after 10m.
oncall-mike: Handoff to night oncall @sre-ana at 1777771400. Will file runbook entry and postmortem pointer.
opsbot: Handoff recorded. Pager cleared for oncall-mike. Keep this thread updated with any manual extension requests.
